source.note: x normalized by width, y by height, sizes by width unless stated. Times in seconds of the original.

moon.kind: measured (moon+cloud blob centroid; radius from blob height)

brand_logo.note: size includes the glow until ~0.97 s; core logo width settles at 0.161 W

ui_camera.kind: measured (direct registration to f87, scale+translation, no roll: Hough check shows 0.00 deg)
ui_camera.meaning: screen = s * (p - centre) + (cx, cy), p in anchor-frame pixels

code_camera.kind: measured (chained, anchor f240 = 8.0 s; scale about the frame centre)
code_camera.note: first value (7.167) is an extrapolated estimate: the tracker had too few points

writing.scale_note: 8.6 and 8.633 are estimates (glyphs too blurred to measure)

coding.zoom_note: 10.667 and 10.7 estimated from frame-to-frame scale (letters already dissolving)

end_logo.kind: measured from 11.9 s; 11.733-11.867 core size estimated (bloom)

end_card_scale.kind: measured (frame-to-frame scale of the end icon)

light.kind: estimate (warm-glow peak/centroid with text masked; broad and noisy)
keys: born from the moon at frame centre
sweeps to top left with the whip (0.27, 0.0)
right edge strip, rising 0.8 -> 0.4, brightest of the film
bottom left corner + top right corner
light.dark_floor: pure black (Y 0-1) outside the light from 2.3 s on
